purpose: The OT pilot after the plant moved to its own trust domain and an independent effect verifier was added: battery, fault injection, the 24 independent scenarios, the E boundary procedure and the G effect-verification run, each on a stack reset with down -v.

source.note: Images built from the working tree at 5bcbdaa8. The host-side runners ran from 564a553b, which differs from it only in deploy/ot-pilot/run_boundary_assessment.py (the record keeps a count of leaked credential values instead of names) and a test; neither file is in an image.
source.build_note: Built in a sandbox behind an egress proxy. The API image: docker build --network host, the proxy as build arguments, its CA bind-mounted for the pip step only (RUN --mount, not copied into the image). Docker Hub answered 429 to the base image's metadata request, so python:3.12-slim was pulled from mirror.gcr.io/library/python:3.12-slim and tagged locally; its digest is in images.base_image_digest. The console was not built or started.
source.toolspec_note: The ToolSpec bundle was re-signed (build_toolspec.py --force) after ot_registry.py changed. A first run on this build used the bundle signed before that change: REMORA refused the changed callables (toolspec_callable_digest_mismatch, HTTP 500 at execute) and nothing ran. That run is not used here; the re-signed run is.
